modalities.evidence: one treatment planning CT and two CBCT scans from each patient
received ablative radiation therapy (>= 100Gy biologically effective dose)

output.population: 40 patients who received ablative radiation therapy for locally advanced pancreatic cancer at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, data obtained retrospectively with IRB approval.
output.summary: Breath-hold planning CT and cone-beam CT scans with expert manual organ-at-risk segmentations, collected to evaluate CT-to-CBCT deformable registration and auto-segmentation algorithms in pancreatic cancer radiation therapy.
